scope: Clio Manage matters (list, detail, matter dashboard, statuses, stages, matter templates, numbering, custom fields and field sets, related contacts, relationships, permissions, notifications, notes, firm feed, personal dashboard, Manage AI on matters) and contacts (people/companies, contact dashboard, custom fields, tags, rates, merge, delete/recover, import). Method note: help.clio.com returned 403 to direct fetch and web.archive.org is blocked for this agent, so help-centre facts come from search-result snippets of official help.clio.com articles (medium confidence); docs.developers.clio.com matters and custom-fields guides were opened directly (high).
clio_products: Clio Grow (only where it shares data: tags, matter conversion)

features.name: Matter core record and required fields
features.what: A matter needs a client contact and a description; other fields include status, practice area, responsible attorney, originating attorney, responsible staff, stage, display number, open date, billable flag and a free-text client reference.

features.name: Matter statuses open / pending / closed with a date per status
features.where: Matter form > Matter details > Matter status; Matter dashboard > Details > Status
features.what: Three fixed statuses. The help centre describes pending as either a prospective matter or one being prepared to close; the API guide describes pending as created but not yet opened. Each status change stamps open_date, pending_date or close_date.

features.name: Bulk status change and bulk close
features.where: Matters > tick rows > Edit > Update matter status
features.what: Select several matters and set a new status, including Close, in one action.

features.name: Closed matters are read-only; reopen by status change
features.what: A closed matter cannot be edited; you reopen it, edit, and close again. Clio recommends closing over deleting.

features.name: Matters list filters, columns and CSV export
features.where: Matters > status quick filters > Filters / Columns / Export
features.what: Quick filters by status; filters by contact, responsible or originating attorney, matter notifications, billable, practice area, tag, custom fields and keyword. Custom fields can be added as columns. CSV export covers all filtered matters, with all or only visible columns. No saved views were found in the sources.

features.name: Matter dashboard
features.what: One page showing financials (work in progress, outstanding balance, trust funds, budget, time and expenses), basic details, custom fields, a timeline of matter events, the matter's contacts and its related contacts. Admins can set which widgets show and their order, firm-wide.
features.plan_tier: all (widget customization by admins / primary subscriber)

features.name: Matter subtabs (communications, calendar, custom fields, notes, documents, activities, bills)
features.what: Each matter has tabs; Communications gathers phone logs, email logs, texts, internal messages and client portal messages; Custom Fields tab edits field values.

features.name: Matter stages (kanban per practice area)
features.where: Matters > Stages; practice areas in Settings > Firm Preferences > Practice areas
features.what: Each practice area has its own board of up to 15 stages. Only admins create, rename, reorder, delete or set visibility of stages; any user with matter access can move a matter. Matters with a practice area but no stage sit in a 'No Stage Assigned' column. Status controls whether a matter appears on the board. API exposes only the current stage, not history.
features.plan_tier: select plans (not EasyStart per Clio's plan notes; exact tiers unconfirmed)

features.name: Stage-triggered automated workflows
features.what: A stage change can, for example, add a task list to the matter. Links stages, task lists, document templates and matter templates.

features.name: Matter templates with one firm default
features.where: Matters > Matter Templates > New matter template
features.what: Up to 200 templates, created by admins or the primary subscriber. Presets cover matter details (e.g. responsible attorney, stage), custom fields, billing preferences, personal-injury settlement deduction order, document folder structure and task lists. One template can be the firm default; templates can be applied at creation or retroactively to an existing matter.
features.plan_tier: not on all plans (exact tiers unconfirmed)

features.name: Matter numbering scheme
features.what: Admin-only. Default is number plus client summary name; three presets or manual. Starting number defaults to 00001 and can be changed. Applying a scheme to existing matters renumbers all of them and cannot be undone. A firm setting or a per-matter checkbox makes the name/number follow edits to fields in the scheme. API: display_number auto or manual; reset_matter_number regenerates.

features.name: Edit and duplicate matters
features.what: Matters can be duplicated in Manage (steps not visible in snippets). Legal Aid matters duplicated to keep a Unique File Number show a 'Linked matters' section on the dashboard.

features.name: Matter permissions (everyone, users, groups)
features.what: Visible to all firm users by default, or limited to specific users and/or groups (max 20 per matter). Any firm user can set it on create/edit. Admins can filter to matters they are restricted from and bulk-update matter permissions.

features.name: Matter notifications
features.what: A matter form section that names users/groups to notify about the matter; also a matters filter. Exact triggers not confirmed.

features.name: Related contacts on a matter
features.where: Matter dashboard > Related contacts / matter form
features.what: Link non-client contacts (opposing counsel, experts, co-counsel) with a free-text relationship description. API returns name, type, is_matter_client and relationship. Bulk import via migration template keyed on display number plus relationship label.

features.name: Multiple clients on one matter
features.what: A matter has one primary client field, but additional contacts can be flagged as clients (is_client).

features.name: Matter and contact custom fields and field sets
features.what: Admins create fields and sets; anyone fills them. Fields can be default (shown on all forms) and/or required; sets can be default. 64-char names and picklist options. Types: text line, text area, numeric, currency, date, time, checkbox, picklist, contact, matter, email, URL. Individually added fields go into a 'General' set. Usable as document merge fields. Filterable and addable as columns.

features.name: Notes on matters and contacts, with time
features.where: Matter or Contact > Notes subtab > New note
features.what: Notes attach to a matter or a contact. Recording time on a note opens a time entry after save. Notes list filters: all, with time, without time. Edit and duplicate from the Actions column.

features.name: Firm Feed
features.what: Listed as a tab beside the Personal and Firm dashboards. No official description of contents or filters found. Note: Clio 'Activities' means time and expense entries, not an activity log.

features.name: Personal dashboard
features.what: Hourly metrics (billable time vs target set in Settings > Profile > Personal Performance), Today's Agenda (tasks and events due today), financial metrics for permitted users.

features.name: Manage AI: proactive AI Actions on the matter dashboard
features.what: Suggested next steps from recent matter activity: draft client update, events captured from documents, bills ready for approval, suggested time entries from unlogged communications/notes/tasks. Clicking starts the action. Admin must enable and accept terms.
features.plan_tier: Essentials, Advanced, Expand (per help; plan names reportedly renamed 2026)

features.name: Manage AI: matter and contact summaries
features.where: AI Launchpad > Ask a question > Catch up on a matter
features.what: Summarizes a matter's operational and financial state (status, WIP, trust, last invoice) and answers contact questions, respecting the user's permissions.

features.name: Manage AI: create notes, tasks, events, time from natural language
features.what: Drafts a time entry, expense, event, task or note from a prompt; user reviews before saving; defaults fill date, user and rate.

features.name: Contacts: person and company
features.what: Person forms have three sections, company forms four (adds Employees). Multiple addresses, emails, phones, websites with a chosen primary for each except address. Prefix/title. Several contacts may share an email. Ending an employee link keeps the person contact.

features.name: Contact dashboard and associated matters
features.what: Shows details, the contact's own matters (if client), associated matters (matters the contact relates to but is not the client of, e.g. co-counsel), custom fields and billing info.

features.name: Contact permissions and client-specific rates
features.where: Contact > Edit > Billing preferences > Add a custom rate
features.what: Per-contact rate for chosen users or groups; matter rate overrides client rate. Contacts can also carry permissions.

features.name: Tags shared by contacts and matters
features.what: One coloured tag list for contacts and matters; admins manage it, anyone applies. Up to 50 tags per contact and 3,000 contact tags per account. Deleting a tag removes it everywhere permanently.

features.name: Contact merge (manual only)
features.what: No merge tool. You pick a primary, rename the duplicate, repoint each matter's client, recreate associated-matter links, move the rest, then delete the secondary. Bills and payments follow the matter. No bulk edit for contacts.

features.name: Contact delete, Recovery Bin and bulk operations
features.where: Contact > Delete; Settings > Recovery Bin; Settings > Bulk operations
features.what: Single/table deletes go to the Recovery Bin for six months; recovered contacts may be incomplete. Deleting loses notes, portal and co-counsel access; matters and bills remain but unlinked. Admin bulk operations can delete all contacts or exact duplicates, unrecoverably, and skip duplicates that have matters, notes or transactions.
features.plan_tier: all (bulk operations admin / primary subscriber only)

features.name: Contact import via migration templates
features.where: Settings > Imports > Add > Contacts from Outlook CSV
features.what: CSV in Clio's fixed template (headers must not change). Persons are created then linked to companies; missing companies are created empty. Import contacts before matters. Separate templates for contact custom fields and related contacts. No vCard import found.

features.name: Data residency (Canadian server) and AI processing
features.what: Clio has US and Canadian servers; data at rest stays in region, but AI responses may be processed temporarily outside the account's region.

gaps.feature: Responsible staff as a distinct matter role
gaps.proposal: Add Matter.responsible_staff_id (ref User) beside responsible and originating lawyer; show in matter-list column picker and filters; agent routes clerk-level tasks to this person by default.

gaps.feature: Apply a matter template to an existing matter
gaps.proposal: Action 'Apply template to matter' on matter-overview: preview diff (fields, folders, tasks to add; nothing overwritten without a tick), gated by responsible lawyer. Agent suggests the best-fit template when a matter has none.

Action 'Duplicate matter' (e.g. appeal, second transaction for same client): copies practice area, parties as proposals, custom fields, team; new number; creates a related_matters link 'duplicated from'; new conflict-relevant parties still pass G2.
Board shows a 'No stage' column for matters with a practice area but no stage; agent proposes a stage for each from evidence. Decide our own cap (Clio: 15 per area) or state none.
Clio exposes only the current stage. Keep days_in_stage and record every stage move in the activity timeline; surface 'time in each stage' per matter as a differentiator.

gaps.feature: Admin view of matters they are restricted from + bulk permission update
gaps.proposal: Decide deliberately: our admin must not see walled content. Add admin-only 'Access report' listing matter numbers and visibility (no names/contents for walled matters) and a gated bulk 'change visibility' (G-BK + responsible lawyer). Cap or no cap on grants per matter.

gaps.feature: Firm-level matter dashboard layout (admin sets widget order)
gaps.proposal: Add firm default card order for matter-overview set by admin, with per-user override; per-practice-area layouts so the agent shows the right key facts first.
Add 'time' (and confirm 'long text', 'URL', 'email' already listed) to field_type so Clio migration maps every type 1:1.

gaps.feature: Custom fields usable as document merge fields
gaps.proposal: State in documents templates that every matter/contact custom field key is a merge variable; retired fields render blank with a warning.

gaps.feature: Contact Recovery Bin (6-month undo of delete)
gaps.proposal: We archive rather than delete. Add an 'Archived' tab with restore, and for true erasure keep the name-only conflict stub (open question already raised). Note Clio's bulk delete is unrecoverable; ours never is without G-CM.

gaps.feature: Associated matters on a contact (contact related to matters it is not client of)
gaps.proposal: contact-detail: add explicit 'Roles across matters' list (from MatterRole) split into Client of / Party to / Counsel on, each linking the matter and respecting walls (walled matters counted as 'restricted').

gaps.feature: Client-specific rates per user/group with matter-over-client precedence
gaps.proposal: billing_defaults should hold per-user and per-group rate overrides; document precedence: matter rate > client rate > user default. Billing area owns the rule.
Allow restricting a sensitive contact (e.g. family-law client) to named users/groups; conflict search still finds the name but shows 'restricted contact'.

gaps.feature: Tag limits and admin-only tag creation
gaps.proposal: Decide: admins curate the shared tag list, others apply only (Clio model), or anyone creates with agent dedupe. Deleting a tag shows a count of affected records and is undoable for 30 days.

Dry run shows companies to be created from person rows (Clio creates empty companies silently) and requires contacts before matters in a Clio import; accept Clio's migration CSV templates directly, including related-contacts and custom-field templates.

gaps.feature: Manage AI proactive AI Actions and summaries
gaps.proposal: Already covered by agent next-actions; keep the claim that ours are cited and gated, and that Clio's are suggestions started by the user.
my_time_today exists; add annual target, working days and fiscal year end (Clio's Personal Performance inputs) in user settings.
followers covers it; allow groups as followers, matching Clio.
No evidence Clio has saved filters; ours is a possible edge. Keep.

corrections.our_claim: matters.json clio_gaps: Firm feed lives at 'Activities / Firm Feed' in Clio
corrections.truth: In Clio, 'Activities' are time and expense entries, not an activity log. Firm Feed is a separate tab next to the dashboards; its contents and filters are not documented in sources found.

corrections.our_claim: matters.json clio_gaps: Contact import from CSV/vCard/Outlook
corrections.truth: Only CSV in Clio's migration template ('Contacts from Outlook CSV') was found; no vCard import is documented.

corrections.our_claim: matters.json clio_gaps: 'Related matters' at Matter dashboard > Related matters
corrections.truth: Not confirmed. Clio documents 'associated matters' on a contact's dashboard and 'Linked matters' for duplicated Legal Aid matters; a general matter-to-matter related-matters feature was not found.

corrections.our_claim: matters.json clio_gaps: Matter templates preset 'team roles' and link a work template
corrections.truth: Clio templates preset matter details (incl. responsible attorney, stage), custom fields, billing preferences, PI settlement deduction order, document folders and task lists; max 200 per firm; can be applied retroactively. Our mapping is fine but should cite the 200 cap and retroactive apply.

corrections.our_claim: matters.json clio_gaps: Matter stages are on all Clio plans (implied 'already covered' parity)
corrections.truth: Clio says stages and templates are on select plans only; stage-triggered automated workflows are Advanced and Expand only.

corrections.our_claim: versus-clio: 'Data: AI may process outside Canada'
corrections.truth: Supported, with nuance: Clio offers a Canadian server for data at rest, and states AI generation may be processed temporarily outside the account region. Word it as 'data can stay in Canada; AI processing may leave it'.

corrections.our_claim: versus-clio: 'People work; AI assists on request'
corrections.truth: Partly outdated: Manage AI shows proactive AI Actions on the matter dashboard without a request (drafts, captured events, suggested time). The real difference is that ours does the work first with citations and a gate.
